Enqueue one durable acquisition job.

Source: R/acquisition_queue.R
acquisition_queue_enqueue.Rd

Repeating the same target is idempotent for discovery and download jobs; relocation jobs use their source/target idempotency key. The target must already be an identity in the acquisition catalog.

Usage

acquisition_queue_enqueue(
  catalog,
  kind,
  target_type,
  target_ref_id,
  host = NULL,
  priority = 0L,
  max_attempts = 3L,
  delay_seconds = 0,
  idempotency_key = NULL,
  estimated_bytes = NULL
)

Arguments

catalog

A catalog from acquisition_catalog_open().

kind

discover, download, migrate_storage, or ingest.

target_type

source, document, file, or storage_root.

target_ref_id

Persisted source, document, file, or storage-root ID.

host

Optional shared host throttle key.

priority

Integer priority; larger values claim first.

max_attempts

Bounded number of worker attempts.

delay_seconds

Delay before the first claim.

idempotency_key

Optional caller key. The persisted target identity remains unique even when a caller key is supplied.

estimated_bytes

Optional transfer-size estimate used by storage reservations.

Value

A list containing job_id and status.
